---
title: "Max My Literacy"
subtitle: "Building word knowledge for every learner"
---

Max My Literacy is a curriculum-based vocabulary tool for primary school students, designed with EAL/D and multilingual learners in mind. It helps children learn the words they meet in their classroom subjects, then brings those words back over time so they are practised, re-used and applied in new contexts.

The tool is grounded in the science of learning and developed by researchers at Macquarie University and their partners.
